document.headline: Federal Reserve Releases Minutes From October 27–28, 2026 FOMC Meeting
document.excerpt: The Federal Reserve published the minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting held on October 27–28, 2026, noting that such records are generally released three weeks after a policy decision.

takeaways: The Federal Reserve released the minutes of the October 27–28, 2026 Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
The Fed said regularly scheduled meeting minutes are generally published three weeks after the policy decision.
The central bank said the minutes reflect information available to the Committee at the time of the meeting.

sections.heading: Federal Reserve posts October meeting minutes

paragraphs.text: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released the minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting held on October 27–28, 2026. The announcement was posted by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. [11111111-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-111111111111]

In its release, the central bank said minutes for each regularly scheduled meeting of the Committee are generally published three weeks after the day of the policy decision. It also said the descriptions of economic and financial conditions in the minutes are based solely on information available to the Committee at the time of the meeting.
